import pandas as pd, numpy as np
pd.set_option('display.max_rows',100); pd.set_option('display.width',240); pd.set_option('display.max_columns',30)
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv'); df['date']=pd.to_datetime(df['date'],format='%m/%d/%y')
keys=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
target=pd.Timestamp('2025-10-20')
base_dates=pd.date_range('2025-10-10','2025-10-19')
t=df[df.date.eq(target)].groupby(keys,dropna=False).agg(target_cost=('unblended_cost','sum'),target_price=('price','mean'),target_price_min=('price','min'),target_price_max=('price','max'),target_instances=('num_instances','mean'))
b=df[df.date.isin(base_dates)].groupby(keys,dropna=False).agg(base_cost=('unblended_cost','mean'),base_cost_min=('unblended_cost','min'),base_cost_max=('unblended_cost','max'),base_price=('price','mean'),base_price_min=('price','min'),base_price_max=('price','max'),base_instances=('num_instances','mean'),base_days=('date','nunique'))
r=t.join(b,how='outer').fillna(0)
r['delta']=r.target_cost-r.base_cost
r['ratio']=r.target_cost/r.base_cost.replace(0,np.nan)
print('Top 50 resource cost increases vs 10-day baseline:')
print(r.sort_values('delta',ascending=False).head(50).to_string())
print('\nTop 30 price ratio:')
print(r.sort_values('ratio',ascending=False).head(30).to_string())
print('\nExact duplicate key-date count:',df.duplicated(['date']+keys).sum())
print('Unique resources:',df[keys].drop_duplicates().shape[0])
